about.html.a: Crib Market operates as a multi-asset broker licensed from the USA. Client balances are held separately from company funds, with security controls in place across the trading environment.
You trade on MetaTrader 5. That covers desktop terminals, iOS and Android apps, and browser access so you can work from wherever you sit.

about.html.q: How are client funds looked after?
about.html.a: Money you deposit is kept in segregated accounts at established banks. It is not mixed with Crib Market operating capital.

about.html.q: Can traders in the United States open an account?
about.html.a: Crib Market is licensed from the USA and onboards clients in many countries, including the United States. Local rules where you live can still limit which products you may use.

forex.html.q: What makes Crib Market a fit for FX?
forex.html.a: Pricing is published clearly, orders are handled quickly, and the desk stays available when you need help. Those conditions suit both first FX trades and more active styles.

forex.html.q: Is FX trading with Crib Market secure?
forex.html.a: Yes. International operating standards apply, client money sits in segregated accounts, and sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

forex.html.q: Can I practice before going live?
forex.html.a: A demo account lets you run FX ideas against live prices using virtual funds, so you can learn the platform without putting capital at risk.

forex.html.q: Where do I place forex trades?
forex.html.a: MetaTrader 5 is the venue: desktop, web, and mobile. Charts, orders, and account tools sit in one place.

forex.html.q: Do I need to be a professional to trade FX?
forex.html.a: No. New traders can start after learning the basics. Demo access and onboarding materials are there so you can build confidence first.

indices.html.q: What is an index CFD at Crib Market?
indices.html.a: An index follows a basket of listed companies. You can take a view on benchmarks such as US30, NASDAQ, FTSE, and DAX through CFDs, with published spreads and fast fills.
Hours track the cash market underneath each contract. Many major index CFDs can be traded across global sessions, with extra coverage on selected symbols.

indices.html.q: Are there overnight charges on indices?
indices.html.a: Positions held past the daily cutoff can attract swap. Review those costs on MetaTrader 5 before you hold a trade overnight.

indices.html.q: Do index CFDs have an expiry?
indices.html.a: Crib Market lists rolling contracts with no set end date and futures-style contracts that do expire. Check the specification for the symbol you plan to trade.

indices.html.q: How much leverage is available on indices?
indices.html.a: Index leverage can reach 1:500 depending on the account and the instrument. Gearing magnifies losses as well as gains, so size positions with care.

commodities.html.a: Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), WTI and Brent crude, and other listed commodities are available as CFDs, each with published spreads and active liquidity.

commodities.html.q: Why trade commodities with Crib Market?
commodities.html.a: You follow live prices and can take a view without storing metal or oil. That is useful for hedging or expressing a directional idea.
Selected commodities support leverage up to 1:500. Margin requirements vary by account type and by symbol.
Some follow a futures calendar and expire; others roll with no fixed date. Read the product sheet in the platform before you open a position.
You typically pay the spread, overnight swap if you hold past cutoff, and occasional rollover adjustments. Those figures appear in MetaTrader 5.

shares.html.a: A share CFD tracks a listed company's price without transferring ownership of the stock. You can go long or short as the share moves.
Large-cap listings from the US, UK, and Europe commonly appear on multi-asset books. What you can trade depends on the symbols enabled for your account.
You do not receive the cash dividend. Around the ex-dividend date, a cash adjustment is usually credited if you are long and debited if you are short.
Where the product is offered, leverage may apply, often up to 1:500, subject to the stock and the rules that govern it.
Expect the spread, overnight financing, and in some markets a commission. Charges for enabled products are shown in the platform.

etfs.html.a: Crypto CFDs let you trade price moves in digital assets without holding coins. You can go long or short as the market swings.
Typical offerings include Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Litecoin (LTC), Ripple (XRP), and other widely traded coins.
No. You are not buying coins, so there is nothing to store. Positions sit inside your Crib Market trading account.

etfs.html.q: Is leverage available on crypto CFDs?
etfs.html.a: Yes, often up to 1:500, subject to volatility and the rules that apply to the symbol.

etfs.html.q: When can I trade crypto CFDs?
etfs.html.a: These markets usually run around the clock, including weekends, so you can react whenever the tape is moving.

crypto.html.q: How do crypto CFDs work at Crib Market?
crypto.html.a: Each CFD follows a digital-asset price. You open a long or short position and close it when your target or stop is hit, without owning the coin.

crypto.html.q: Which coins can I trade as CFDs?
crypto.html.a: Leading names such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Ripple are typically available, along with additional major coins.
No. Settlement stays inside your Crib Market account. You never take delivery of coins.

crypto.html.q: Can I use leverage on crypto CFDs?
crypto.html.a: Leverage is available and can reach 1:500 depending on the market and applicable limits.
Crypto CFD books generally run 24/7, including weekends.

all-accounts.html.q: How do I open a live account?
all-accounts.html.a: Register on the site, complete identity checks (KYC), fund the account, then you can place live trades.
Yes. Open a demo at any time and practice with virtual funds against live market prices.
Match the account to capital and style. Standard starts at $100 with 1:200 leverage, Growth at $500 with 1:300, and Edge at $10,000 with 1:100. All three are swap-free.

all-accounts.html.q: Can someone else trade my account?
all-accounts.html.a: No. Only you may operate the account. Sharing login details breaches our terms.

all-accounts.html.q: Can I change account type or currency later?
all-accounts.html.a: Contact support to request a change. Approval can depend on recent activity and other conditions.

cent-account.html.q: How do I pick the right account?
cent-account.html.a: Look at experience, goals, and capital. Standard, Growth, and Edge cover different starting points.

cent-account.html.q: Can I try a demo first?
cent-account.html.a: Yes. A demo uses virtual funds in live market conditions so you can learn the platform first.

cent-account.html.q: May someone else place trades for me?
cent-account.html.a: No. Only the registered holder may trade. Sharing access is not allowed.

cent-account.html.q: Can my account type or currency be updated?
cent-account.html.a: Yes. Write to support to request a change; some limits may apply.
MetaTrader 5 on desktop, web, and mobile.

standard-account.html.q: How should I choose an account type?
standard-account.html.a: Weigh skill, goals, and funding. Standard, Growth, and Edge are built for different starting deposits and leverage.
Yes. Practice with virtual capital against real prices before you go live.

standard-account.html.q: Can I authorize someone else to trade?
standard-account.html.a: No. Only the account owner may place trades.

standard-account.html.q: Can I alter my account type or currency?
standard-account.html.a: Ask support. Restrictions can apply depending on your situation.

standard-account.html.q: What trading platforms can I use?
standard-account.html.a: MetaTrader 5 is available on desktop, web, and mobile.

ecn-account.html.q: Which account fits my trading style?
ecn-account.html.a: Capital and style guide the choice. Standard, Growth, and Edge use different minimum deposits and leverage, all with swap-free terms.

ecn-account.html.q: Can I open a demo before going live?
ecn-account.html.a: Yes. Demo accounts use virtual funds with live pricing.
No. Only the account holder may trade. Do not share your login.

ecn-account.html.q: How do I change account type or base currency?
ecn-account.html.a: Send a request to support. Approval can depend on recent activity.

ecn-account.html.q: Which platforms does an Edge account use?
ecn-account.html.a: MetaTrader 5 on desktop, web, and mobile.

gold-account.html.a: The right fit depends on background and aims. Standard, Growth, and Edge cover a range of starting points.

gold-account.html.q: Can I practice on a demo account?
gold-account.html.a: Yes. Open a demo and trade virtual funds against real-time prices.
Demos often close after a period of inactivity. Support can advise on timing and extensions.
MetaTrader 5 on desktop, web, and mobile.

gold-account.html.q: How do I start a live account?
gold-account.html.a: Sign up, finish verification, deposit, and you can trade live.

platforms.html.q: What trading tools does Crib Market provide?
platforms.html.a: MetaTrader 5 brings multi-asset charts, professional order types, and access to forex and CFD markets in one terminal.
Yes. Download account history from the client portal whenever you need a record of activity.

platforms.html.q: Which markets can I trade with Crib Market?
platforms.html.a: Forex plus CFDs on indices, commodities, and cryptocurrencies, subject to the symbols enabled on your account.

platforms.html.q: How do I sign in to my trading account?
platforms.html.a: Open the Crib Market client portal and log in with the account number, password, and server details we send after registration.

platforms.html.q: What happens to open trades if I log out?
platforms.html.a: Positions stay on the server after you close the app. They exit only if a stop or take-profit is hit, or if you close them yourself.

partner-ib.html.q: How do I open a live account as a partner client?
partner-ib.html.a: Complete registration on the website, verify identity, and fund through a method listed in the client portal.

partner-ib.html.q: Which trading account suits me best?
partner-ib.html.a: Style, capital, and experience decide it. Standard, Growth, and Edge each use different deposit and leverage terms.

partner-ib.html.q: Can someone else manage my trades?
partner-ib.html.a: Only if they are properly licensed and you have a formal, compliant agreement. Informal handovers are not recommended.

partner-ib.html.q: Can I change account type or currency after signup?
partner-ib.html.a: Type and base currency are set at registration. Ask support for a change, or open a new account with the settings you want.
Bank transfer, card, and other methods listed in your Crib Market client portal.
